subject: The one citation mistake 90% of students make
preview_text: You're probably doing it wrong right now. Here's the truth about academic citations and why your professor notices.
body_paragraphs: Everyone thinks citations are just about avoiding plagiarism. That you can slap some APA format at the end and call it a day. That your professor just skims the bibliography. I used to think that too. Then I got my first paper back with 'superficial sourcing' circled in red.

Here's the secret your professors won't tell you: They don't just check IF you cited. They check HOW you cited. Weak citations = weak argument. Strong citations = academic authority.
